title: Microzone launch: staggered capacity enablement and GTM coordination for new compact_instance family
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Objective: Coordinate a staged launch of compact_instance (compact-g5x) into two microzones (APAC-edge-1 and LATAM-edge-2) with a flexible reservation beta for startup customers. Scope covers launch sequencing, release notes coordination, partner/SE enablement, pricing guardrails, telemetry and post-launch observability. Goal is to validate low-latency routing, measure unit-cost uplift from batching/quantization defaults, and collect feedback from early customers for reservation packaging. This ticket consolidates cross-functional runbook items, release notes drafts, and GTM checkpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Two microzones live with compact_instance available for Dedicated purchases
Reservation beta enabled in dashboard with clear UX and telemetry
Release notes published in product release feed and to partners mailing list
SRE and Runtime teams have baseline SLOs and rollback playbook documented
Customer telemetry (latency, token-cost, errors) reporting enabled and validated
milestones: 2026-03-03: Pricing and reservation beta SKU finalized
2026-03-09: Release notes draft reviewed by Legal & Security
2026-03-14: Internal partner enablement session and console feature flags enabled
2026-04-01: Public availability and broadcast release notes
risks: Unexpected kernel regressions on compact_instance causing latency spikes
Telemetry gaps between edge microzones and central dashboard
Billing reconciliation issues for partial-month reservation swaps
Partner confusion over SKU naming leading to mis-sold commitments
comm_tasks: Draft release notes (summary + technical appendix) and circulate for review
Prepare partner README + SKU cheat sheet for Sales/SEs
Create a short video demo for partner enablement playbook
Coordinate customer email list for soft-open invitations
Update pricing docs and reservation FAQ in support site
Schedule post-launch telemetry review (D+3) with SRE and Runtime
notes: Decision: default quantization profile for compact_instance will be q4_0 to balance cost/latency (agreed 2026-03-02)
Trade-off: enabling aggressive batching cuts unit cost but increases P95 latency; will use dynamic batching thresholds controlled by microzone policies
Follow-up: evaluate bundling flexible reservations with 1-month minimum vs existing 3-months after pilot metrics
Docs owner Lina will publish initial console screenshots by 2026-03-12
